FULL TEXT:
Centre for Human Rights & Duties
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Advertisement
Faculty Position Teaching of Subjects Honorarium Duration *
Guest Faculty (1) Value Added Course
(Understanding Human
Rights)
Multi-Disciplinary
Course (MDC)
(Human Rights and
Duties in India) under
NEP
Rs.1500 per lecture
basis with the ceiling of
Rs.50, 000 per month
Odd Semester 2024-25
(*Extendable as per
Panjab University
Norms/ Rules)
Essential Qualifications (As per UGC / PU norms) :
i) A Master ‘s degree in Human Rights and Duties with 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/Physically &
Visually handicapped candidates) an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is
followed from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.
ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test
(NET) conducted by the UGC.
Desirable Qualifications
The candidate should have Ph. D in Human Rights & Duties or experience in teaching Postgraduate classes
in human rights.
Honorarium: Rs.1500 per lecture basis with the ceiling of Rs.50, 000 per month.
Note: Duly filled hard copy of the application form and template pages 1 to 11
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationform
asperugcregulation2018.pdf) be submitted on 09.09.2024 by 4:30 p.m. at O/o Chairperson, Centre for
Human Rights and Duties. Late applications will not be considered and will stand rejected. Verification of
the original documents of the candidates along with photocopies of the same will be done at the time of
interview. At the time of interview (physical presence of the candidate is mandatory). The candidates are
required to bring all the supporting documents/certificates/publications in original. Candidates are
required to report at 10:30 a.m. sharp on the date of interview at O/o Chairperson, Centre for Human Rights
and Duties. The candidates are advised to keep checking the Panjab University and CHRD noticeboard for
further updates. The candidates shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching at Centre for Human
Rights and Duties, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty.
No individual intimation will be sent. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Prof. Namita Gupta
Chairperson
Centre for Human Rights & Duties
